notes: This is an action reference, not a bucket/CAM policy document. Review only missing action additions with the existing identity owner.
Do not replace gooodwork rules, principals, or the shared SecretId/SecretKey. No wildcard browser key resources.
Bucket metadata/list actions may need bucket-specific resources and prefix conditions; an exact object example is not proof that CAM accepts it for a list action.
Application prefix checks do not isolate the shared long-term credential from other projects.
The probe additionally reads GetObjectACL only for its own objects to verify private ACL; it never changes bucket versioning/CORS/policy.
